description: Defines a custom ImageView subclass that manages drawable display state notifications for recycling bitmaps, aiding in efficient bitmap memory management in an Android app.

classes.name: RecyclingImageView
classes.description: A specialized ImageView subclass that notifies its drawable(s) when it is displayed or detached, facilitating proper bitmap recycling.

methods.name: RecyclingImageView(Context)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RecyclingImageView with a Context.

methods.name: RecyclingImageView(Context, AttributeSet)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RecyclingImageView with a Context and attribute set.

methods.name: onDetachedFromWindow
methods.description: Overrides ImageView method to clear the drawable when the view is detached from window, preventing memory leaks.

methods.name: setImageDrawable
methods.description: Overrides ImageView method to notify the drawable(s) whether they are currently displayed or not.
